evidence: Modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp`, `src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp`, `src/rpc/util.cpp`, and `src/rest.cpp` to return candidate block hashes for pruned transaction lookups.
rationale: Allows RPC and REST callers to distinguish between missing transactions and pruned transactions, providing candidate block hashes so callers can fetch missing blocks via `getblockfrompeer`.
